summary: Iter31 end-to-end verification of TapPresence Stripe checkout + pricing single-source-of-truth + registration flows + landing polish. Backend pytest 10/10 PASSED (test_iter31_stripe_pricing.py). Verified: (1) SUPER_ADMIN /admin/control/pricing/preview returns price diff {pro_month: before/after}; /publish with patch {regional_pricing:{USD:{pro_month:12.49}}} updates commercial_config; GET /commercial/pricing?market=USD returns pricing.pro_month=12.49; new POST /billing/checkout for Pro creates a Stripe hosted session and inserts payment_transactions with amount=1249 cents (verified via direct MongoDB inspection); reverted to 9.99 confirmed via /commercial/pricing. (2) POST /billing/subscribe returns HTTP 402 for a fresh trial workspace owner — no unpaid bypass. (3) Individual registration creates workspace type=individual, plan=trial, subscription.status=trialing with pending_plan=pro and trial_ends_at set. (4) Team registration with seats=3, interval=month creates type=company workspace, subscription.status=trialing, pending_plan=team, seats=3, interval=month; direct POST with seats=2 correctly rejected 400. (5) Team checkout for 4 seats × $5/seat_month created Stripe session with payment_transactions.amount=2000 cents (verified in Mongo). (6) SUPER_ADMIN login returns role=SUPER_ADMIN. Frontend Playwright (mobile 390 + desktop 1920): landing hero-stats shows only truthful capability labels (NFC+QR/AI/Wallet/Live) — no fabricated '50K+/1M+' numbers; benefit-0/1/2 present with no 'Google' or named endorsements; template-carousel renders template-card-real_estate/technology/healthcare/finance; legacy testid template-executive-black-gold absent; explore-templates present; landing-plan-pro-price renders (99.99/year with Annual toggle default; monthly resolves to 9.99); brand + brand-lockup present on / and /login and /register; Register page shows acct-individual/acct-team toggle; selecting team reveals team-setup with seats-count=3 initial, seats-dec cannot go below 3 (3x clicks still 3), team-total='$15.00/mo', seats-min-note 'Minimum 3 seats.', team-trial-note present; back-to-home present on /login and /register; login 'Create your account' present, no 'Create your ID' string on /login; admin@ariadni.id / Ariadni@2026 login redirects SUPER_ADMIN to /control. Arabic locale switch: <html dir='rtl'>, scrollWidth==clientWidth at 390 (no horizontal overflow). Live Stripe checkout flow: registered fresh individual → /billing → plan-pro-cta clicked → browser navigated to https://checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_... hosted checkout page (session created & redirected successfully). /payment/success?session_id=... route renders 'Confirming your payment...' polling UI without JS errors. Hosted Stripe checkout completion with 4242 test card was NOT automated (checkout.stripe.com automation blocked / out of iframe scope) but session creation + success-page rendering verified as fallback per request.
critical_code_review_comments: billing_checkout stores payment_transactions.amount as unit_amount*seats which equals the first-period charge in cents — matches user's KEY gate (pro at $12.49 → 1249; team 4 seats × $5 → 2000).

billing_subscribe correctly gated by ALLOW_DEMO_BILLING env; recommend removing this endpoint entirely once Stripe is claimed to eliminate any residual attack surface (currently returns 402 which is safe).
register() enforces min_seats from commercial_config both server-side (HTTP 400) and via frontend disable of seats-dec at min — good defense-in-depth.

payment_status endpoint is unauthenticated by design (required for the success poll after Stripe redirect) — safe because it only exposes status/plan for a session_id that Stripe returns to the browser after successful redirect; consider rate-limiting to prevent scraping.

Trial card on public landing still shows 'Start free' CTA text — semantically it is a 14-day trial (not a free plan), so copy is acceptable, but consider renaming to 'Start trial' to match the 'NO public Free plan' requirement wording strictly.

seed_data_creation: None persisted. All TEST_iter31_* users, workspaces, memberships, payment_transactions, sessions, and email_verifications deleted at teardown. commercial_config USD.pro_month reverted to 9.99. feras-askar and other seeded accounts untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter31 fully verified. Backend pytest file: /app/backend/tests/test_iter31_stripe_pricing.py (run with `pytest backend/tests/test_iter31_stripe_pricing.py -o addopts=''`). The pricing publish→checkout amount pipeline is the KEY user gate and is confirmed via direct Mongo inspection of payment_transactions (pro at 12.49 → amount=1249; reverted to 9.99). Stripe hosted checkout completion with the 4242 test card was NOT automated in this iteration (out-of-origin iframe / anti-bot); if that flow needs full automation next iteration, use Stripe Test Clocks or the Stripe CLI to simulate the checkout.session.completed webhook against /api/webhook/stripe (the _handle_completed_session path is already implemented at platform_v1.py:731).
